facts.text: Cedric signed a promissory note to pay the party three-quarters price for the barrow treasure, tallied by Dr. Uriah at about 975 gold pieces. It can be collected only once the caravans flow again and the goods can be trucked out through his messenger's arrangement.
facts.uncertain_reason: The note was used to recruit Malzazarik and Lady Hilda (beat_64). It is unclear whether the party still holds it or has pledged it to them.

facts.text: Cedric cannot pay on the promissory note until the shipments stopped by the dragon flow again.
The party owes the wizard Malzazarik and Lady Hilda payment for joining, offered against Cedric's promissory note.
facts.uncertain_reason: Play never stated the share, terms or timing of payment from the note.
